comment: Bulk editing is useful, but I cannot preview which records will change before I confirm.
The weekly export sometimes arrives after our Monday meeting, so I download it manually.
We need SSO group mapping; manually assigning roles for 300 people is not workable.
I wish the dashboard remembered my date filter when I come back.
Notifications are either everything or nothing. Project-level controls would cut the noise.
Audit-log CSVs use UTC but the screen uses local time, which makes investigations confusing.
A read-only guest role would let clients follow progress without accidental edits.
Saving a report does not save the warehouse filter, so each manager rebuilds it.
SCIM removes people, but their scheduled reports keep running and email former team aliases.
I accidentally changed 84 contacts with bulk edit and had no clear undo option.
Slack alerts need a quiet-hours window. We receive low-priority updates overnight.
Let us filter audit events by API token and export the filtered view.
The mobile dashboard is hard to scan because every card has the same visual weight.
A scheduled report failed for three weeks, but only the creator could see the failure badge.
We need temporary elevated access with an expiration time for incident response.
Please add a confirmation screen that summarizes old and new values for bulk updates.
Different teams want different default dashboard filters instead of one company-wide default.
Role changes can take several minutes to appear, but the admin page says they are complete.
Clients only need comments and downloads; the current member role exposes too much.
Give report owners and admins an alert when a scheduled delivery fails.
